newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Telecom stocks cut by AG Edwards.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telecom stocks cut by AG Edwards.

text.p: A.G. Edwards said on Monday it lowered its ratings on Sprint Corp, Ameritech Corp, NYNEX Corp, SBC Communications Inc and U S West Communications Group, due to valuation.
-- The firm said it lowered Sprint and Ameritech to maintain from accumulate.
-- It cut its rating on NYNEX, U S West Communications and SBC Communications to reduce from maintain, A.G. Edwards said.
-- Analyst Anthony Ferrugia was not immediately available to comment further.
-- Shares of NYNEX were unchanged at 59-1/8, Sprint was up 1/4 at 52-5/8, SBC was down 1/4 at 60-1/2, Ameritech was off 3/8 at 69-3/8 and U S West was off 3/8 at 38.
